data.long_meaning: The name Isitha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Isana’ which means god and ‘Ishita’ which means worshipped or revered. seo.title: Isitha - Goddess of Wisdom and Knowledge in Hinduism
seo.meta_description: Explore the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the Hindu name Isitha. Learn about the goddess of wisdom, knowledge, and learning in Hindu mythology.
seo.description_paragraph: The name Isitha is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Isana’ and ‘Ishita’. It is believed to be the name of the goddess of wisdom and knowledge in Hindu mythology. In Hinduism, Isitha is revered as the goddess of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. She is often depicted as having four arms, carrying a book, a rosary, a bowl of knowledge, and a lotus in each hand. She is also known as the goddess of speech, eloquence, and the arts.
